name: Cal.com Webhook Bookings to Data Table with Email Reminders

parameters.content:
### How it works
The Cal.com Trigger can stop firing since Cal.com retired API v1, so this uses a plain Webhook:
1. **Receive Cal.com Webhook** gets Booking Created, Rescheduled and Cancelled deliveries and checks the `x-cal-signature-256` HMAC over the raw body.
2. Each booking is one Data Table row keyed by `uid`. A reschedule marks the old row `rescheduled` and stores the new one; a cancel marks it `cancelled`; repeats are skipped.
3. Every 5 minutes, booked rows get a first and second reminder email in the attendee's time zone.

### Setup
Needs n8n Data Tables; tested on n8n 2.48.7.
1. Add an SMTP credential to **Send Reminder Email**.
2. In **Booking Settings** set `webhook_secret` (a long random text), `from_email` (a sender your SMTP server accepts), `bookings_table_name`, `first_reminder_hours` and `second_reminder_hours` (keep second smaller).
3. Execute **Run Once to Create Bookings Table** (needs Data Table create permission).
4. Publish (Activate on older versions), copy the Production URL of **Receive Cal.com Webhook**.
5. In Cal.com, Settings > Developer > Webhooks: new webhook with that URL, the same secret, Payload Template left empty, triggers Booking Created, Rescheduled and Cancelled.

### Customization
Edit the email text in **Pick Due Reminders**. Reminders go to the booker; guests are kept in `guest_emails`.

Limits: Cal.com does not retry deliveries. A failed save answers 500 and fails the run; check it in Cal.com and fix the row by hand. Seated event types are not supported. Simultaneous copies of a booking may both be stored; only the oldest gets reminders. A reminder is skipped when booked inside its window, or when sending and releasing both fail. Invalid attendee time zones fall back to the workflow timezone.

## One-time setup
Creates the bookings Data Table with its 17 columns (skipped if it exists).

## Verify the delivery
HMAC of the raw body. Wrong or missing signature, an unsigned empty body too: 401. Signed but not a booking delivery: 400. Not JSON: n8n answers 422. Empty `webhook_secret`: 500 and a failed run. Seated or other events: 200, ignored.

## Find the bookings table
Exact name match. If it is missing, Cal.com gets 503 and the run fails, so it shows in Executions.

## Store the booking
One row per `uid`. Rescheduled marks the old row first; cancelled marks the booked row. A booking already stored is skipped. A failed read or write answers 500 and fails the run.

## Send reminders
Every 5 minutes. Each reminder is claimed in the row before sending, so it goes out once. If the claim or the email fails, the next run tries again (until the meeting starts).
